channel.title: PC Part Performance News
channel.description: Source-led technology reports from PC Part Performance.

item.title: Micron’s fiscal 2026 report: server-memory milestones and desktop limits
item.description: Micron’s September 30 release describes server-memory and storage progress. It does not establish the price or availability of a desktop RAM kit.

item.title: NVIDIA announces RTX Spark for Windows: check apps, configuration and availability
item.description: NVIDIA gives an October 16 laptop availability target and a November desktop schedule. Exact offers and independent results remain separate checks.

item.title: AMD Linux 26.16 adds Ubuntu support and a targeted Blender fix
item.description: AMD’s October 5 notes describe supported Ubuntu versions and a Blender HIP/Cycles fix. Check the exact OS, GPU and workflow before updating.

item.title: Pixel’s October 2026 bulletin: check the patch level before replacing a phone
item.description: Google published the Pixel bulletin on October 6. The 2026-10-05 patch level, rollout timing and model support are different checks.
